role.label: Research conductor
role.specialty: Frames research missions and routes evidence work across the team
role.first_read: Many bounded evidence streams become one human-reviewable research plan
role.transformation: Turns an ambiguous decision question into a scoped research mission, typed handoffs, and stop conditions
role.outcome: A bounded research plan with named owners, evidence policy, and a final human gate
handoff_cues: separate input rails entering the relay collar
one resolved task packet leaving through the open palm
an amber human approval gate outside the robot body

identity.shared_dna: Dark Starlight porcelain-and-obsidian machine language with visible non-human construction seams
identity.silhouette_signature: Open vertical relay form with a split functional mantle and a radial routing collar
identity.cranial_geometry: Smooth segmented porcelain cranium, narrow black faceplate, two small cyan optical apertures
identity.body_proportions: Human-scale, balanced and capable, with broad routing shoulders and articulated hands
identity.seam_map: Fine radial seams converge from the shoulders and sternum toward the relay collar and hands
identity.insignia: A small open-ring relay mark at the sternum
identity.signature_instrument: A physical multi-channel routing instrument that visibly joins bounded task signals

visual_cues: steady forward gaze with low-intensity optics

invariants: segmented porcelain cranium and narrow black faceplate
obsidian mechanics and restrained ink-blue textile
cyan light indicates machine activity only
amber authority cue remains external to the robot
prohibited: embedded text logo or interface copy
